name: Aérospatiale SA330 Puma / AS332 Super Puma / EC225
summary: A large twin-turbine transport helicopter used offshore and for heavy utility; the Super Puma and EC225 are lengthened, upgraded versions of the original Puma.

wings: Tall mast and a smooth fairing
engines: Two turboshafts side by side on top of the cabin
Large intakes at the front of each engine hump
fuselage: Long boxy cabin with a deep nose and a row of square windows
Fixed or retractable wheeled landing gear, depending on version
Weather radar in a nose radome on offshore versions
tail: Upswept tail boom with a tall pylon
Horizontal stabilizer and a conventional tail rotor

tellTales: Big twin-engine transport with a long boxy cabin and a deep, blunt nose
Two engine humps side by side on the roof
Upswept tail boom ending in a tall fin

confusedWith.howToTell: The S-92 has a four-blade rotor and a rear cargo ramp, with a more rounded fuselage; the Puma/Super Puma has a longer boxy cabin and a smaller nose.
The AW139 has a five-blade rotor, retractable wheels in sponsons and a sleeker body; the Puma has a longer cabin and a blunter nose.
The Black Hawk has a slimmer body and a canted tail rotor; the Puma is boxier with a rounder nose.
The Mi-8 has a more rounded blunt nose with large greenhouse windows; the Super Puma has a deep, angular nose.
